colors.name: Earthy Tones (Terracotta, Sage Green, Muted Ochre)
colors.description: Dominant in 'boho nursery' and 'woodland nursery' searches, indicating a preference for natural, calming palettes.

colors.name: Soft Neutrals (Beige, Greige, Warm White)
colors.description: Consistently high search volume across all nursery-related keywords, serving as a versatile base for various design styles, especially for 'cloud wallpaper' and more subdued 'nursery wallpaper' options.

colors.name: Deep Greens (Forest Green, Emerald)
colors.description: Strongly associated with 'woodland nursery' and 'forest wallpaper' searches, highlighting a desire for lush, nature-inspired environments.

colors.name: Dusty Pinks and Blues
colors.description: Appearing in searches for 'nursery wallpaper' and 'cloud wallpaper', suggesting a continued interest in classic, gentle pastels.

styles.name: Bohemian (Boho Chic)
styles.description: High relative search volume for 'boho nursery' and 'modern boho', characterized by natural textures, global patterns, and a relaxed, eclectic feel.

styles.name: Woodland/Forest Themed
styles.description: Significantly trending with 'woodland nursery', 'forest wallpaper', and 'fototapete wald', focusing on depictions of trees, animals (deer, bears, foxes), and nature scenes.

styles.name: Safari/Jungle Themed
styles.description: Consistent interest in 'safari wallpaper' and 'safari jungle', featuring exotic animals (giraffes, elephants, lions) and lush foliage, often in more muted or artistic interpretations.

styles.name: Minimalist/Scandinavian-inspired
styles.description: Underlying trend across multiple keywords, especially with plain or subtly patterned 'nursery wallpaper' and 'cloud wallpaper', emphasizing clean lines, natural materials, and functional design.

styles.name: Whimsical/Dreamy (e.g., Cloud motifs)
styles.description: Driven by 'cloud wallpaper' and 'wolken tapete' searches, aiming for serene, imaginative spaces often with soft colors and ethereal patterns.
